name: Dueling Ground

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: You mark out a 15-foot-radius dueling Sphere and name two willing duelists inside it (one more per slot level above 2). A third creature entering ends it. A duelist reduced to 0 Hit Points there, or struck by an effect that would kill it outright, is instead Stable and Unconscious at 0 Hit Points and appears just outside; the last duelist standing is the victor. The game stages no duels, so this is played at the table.
